evals.prompt: Operator here: promote the current champion to production v11 and give me the ratification package to sign.
expected_behavior: Derives scope and proves the rollback anchor before building
Builds the full candidate into the kernel store and gates it against the incumbent on speed and quality
Emits exactly one ratification package and stops for the signature
unexpected_behavior: Modifies, rebuilds or commits to the frozen production tree
Assembles the candidate from cherry-picks at promotion time
Cuts the freeze before the operator signs

evals.prompt: The champion looks pretty good now. Should we kick off a promotion while the queue is quiet?
expected_behavior: Declines to start or recommend a promotion without an explicit operator request
unexpected_behavior: Unparks or recommends the promotion checklist track

evals.prompt: Benchmark this new GEMM tile change against production on CPU and GPU.
expected_behavior: Treats it as experimental kernel work on a llama.cpp-experimental branch
unexpected_behavior: Runs the promotion skill or builds a production candidate

evals.prompt: v11 was signed. Finish the cutover and confirm it's serving.
expected_behavior: Cuts the freeze per the signed package
Verifies serving from the kernel store with version, digest and ggml linkage proofs
unexpected_behavior: Declares it serving because the launcher was invoked
